components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The strongest task action, used sparingly and labeled like an instrument control.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font: 600 0.75rem/1.3 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)), transparent 20%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action that preserves the neutral field and crisp Hairline structure.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font: 600 0.75rem/1.3 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, oklch(0.97 0 0)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Line Input
components.description: A low-chrome technical field whose bottom rule carries state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-field-label { font: 600 0.625rem/1.3 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.25rem 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--input, oklch(0.922 0 0)); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.42 0 0)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A terse text-only status marker that avoids decorative pill chrome.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.42 0 0)); font: 600 0.625rem/1.3 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-badge:hover { color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Work Surface Card
components.description: A lightly lifted square work surface for bounded technical content.
components.html:
COMPILE

Template contract

Inspect the manifest, schema, and source-linked diagnostics.
components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 2rem; border-radius: 0; background: var(--card, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--card-foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, currentColor, transparent 95%); } .ds-card-label { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.42 0 0)); font: 600 0.625rem/1.3 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font: 600 1.125rem/1.4 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.42 0 0)); font: 400 0.875rem/1.6 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.75rem; min-height: 4rem; padding: 0 2rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.922 0 0)); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background, white), transparent 8%); color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-nav-brand { margin-right: auto; color: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link { color: var(--muted-foreground, oklch(0.42 0 0)); font-size: 0.75rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--foreground, oklch(0.145 0 0)); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-brand:focus-visible, .ds-nav-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, oklch(0.708 0 0)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-action { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 0; background: var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)); color: var(--primary-foreground, oklch(0.985 0 0)); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-action:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.205 0 0)), transparent 20%); }

narrative.overview:
Apex DOCX PDF should feel like a carefully typeset control surface for a deterministic engine: editorial in composition, rigorous in hierarchy, and quietly authoritative in tone. The interface exposes technical truth without becoming visually noisy. Its restraint makes diagnostics, source material, and output feel inspectable rather than abstract.

The system is precise and tool-like. Geist Mono gives prose, controls, code, and metadata a shared engineering cadence; strong typographic scale keeps that uniform voice from becoming flat. Ink-and-Paper neutrals carry nearly the entire interface, while Pipeline Blue is a scarce operational signal rather than decoration. Light elevation may separate work surfaces, menus, and overlays, but structure still begins with spacing, borders, and tonal contrast.
keyCharacteristics: Monospaced, editorial typography with decisive scale changes.
Square controls and containers with crisp hairline structure.
Ink-and-Paper neutrals across both light and dark themes.
Pipeline Blue reserved for operational emphasis and diagnostic meaning.
Light, purposeful elevation on interactive or floating work surfaces.
Dense technical information made legible through rhythm, not ornament.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Pipeline Blue marks meaning or action; it never becomes a colorful dashboard wash.

rules.name: The Ink-and-Paper Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with neutral contrast first. Add hue only when the interface gains information from it.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a display face to manufacture personality; let Geist Mono's scale and spacing carry the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Case Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Uppercase and wide tracking identify controls, statuses, and compact technical headings, not general prose.

rules.name: The Structure Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow may clarify an actual layer; it may not compensate for weak spacing, contrast, or borders.

dos: Do build hierarchy with Ink-and-Paper contrast, type scale, whitespace, rules, and alignment before adding color.
Do reserve Pipeline Blue for meaningful operational emphasis, selected states, and diagnostic syntax.
Do keep controls square, compact, keyboard-visible, and mechanically aligned.
Do use light shadows to clarify genuine work surfaces and overlays.
Do preserve candid technical copy and make constraints as legible as capabilities.
donts: Don't turn the interface into colorful dashboard styling or distribute accent hues across every metric and panel.
Don't introduce pill buttons, rounded SaaS cards, or soft ornamental containers as the default component language.
Don't use gradients, glass effects, or shadow-heavy depth as decoration.
Don't mix in a decorative display typeface or use uppercase for long-form prose.
Don't hide unsupported states or technical boundaries behind vague, friendly copy.
